entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A child riding Vehicle A with their back to the camera, with neck-length short brown hair, wearing a red long-sleeved top and dark blue overalls.

entities.name: Vehicle A

entities.name: lobby floor

entities.name: orange-and-white striped lobby carpet
entities.identification: The rectangular carpet in the center of the lobby, with wide orange and off-white longitudinal stripes and light-colored geometric patterns.

entities.name: staircase
entities.identification: The staircase within the opening in the far wall, with the light-colored side of the flight, thin dark railings, and a brown tread area.

entities.name: interior wall
entities.identification: The light beige walls of the lobby, with squared wall corners, recessed wall sections, and dark baseboards.

entities.name: interior door
entities.identification: The red door panels and dark frame in the recessed area on the right side of the opening image of this clip.

entities.name: ceiling
entities.identification: The light-colored, flat ceiling surface above the lobby, with a crossbeam visible in the opening image.

entities.name: interior ceiling light
entities.identification: The chandelier with a dark ring frame, slender lamp arms, and multiple warm-white illuminated lamp heads.

entities.name: lobby seat
entities.identification: The set of brown upholstered armchairs on both sides of the lobby, dark wooden ladder-back chairs, and light-colored striped armchairs at the far end.

entities.name: potted green plant
entities.identification: The set of green potted plants on the staircase landing and behind the upholstered chair on the right.

entities.name: lobby wall lamp
entities.identification: The set of wall lamps high on the walls, with dark vertical bases, slender lamp arms, and two lamp heads.

entities.name: interior framed picture
entities.identification: The set of rectangular framed pictures on both sides of the lobby and above the staircase, with different subsets of light-colored and darker picture interiors.

entities.name: lobby red wall plate
entities.identification: The red circular wall decoration on the right wall above the potted plant.

entities.name: lobby branch flower arrangement
entities.identification: The decoration to the left of the staircase opening, consisting of thin, forked brown branches spreading upward and outward.
